content: {"rules": ["Model exhibits severe underestimation during high-volatility regimes; forecasts fail to capture sudden price spikes (e.g., +15-20 EUR jumps) even when recent history shows consolidation.", "Forecast horizon is systematically biased downward by approximately 10-15% relative to true outcomes, particularly in the first 7 days of the 30-day window.", "Sentiment signals (0.20/0.33) appear disconnected from price action; model ignores sentiment spikes that precede or coincide with major upward reversion events.", "Model assumes mean-reversion toward recent averages but fails to detect trend acceleration when volatility increases, leading to persistent lag in catching upside moves.", "Correction heuristic: Apply a dynamic upward bias of +10-15 EUR to the 30-day forecast average when historical volatility (range) exceeds 20 EUR and sentiment shows any positive signal."]}
